overview.zh: 研究聚焦高能量密度与脉冲功率等离子体：可解释的多诊断反演、动理学与混合 PIC 模拟，以及快脉冲功率系统仿真。
overview.en: I work on high-energy-density and pulsed-power plasmas: multi-diagnostic inversion, kinetic and hybrid PIC simulation, and fast pulsed-power system modeling.

interests.zh: 科研 AI Harness 工程

themes.lede_zh: 用统一贝叶斯框架把多种诊断绑到同一等离子体状态上，并在 Z 箍缩烧蚀流中抽出可检验的双流体机制。
themes.lede_en: A shared Bayesian engine ties multiple diagnostics to one plasma state, and recovers testable two-fluid mechanisms in Z-pinch ablation flows.
points_zh: 共享贝叶斯神经网络核心 + 可切换物理正向模型：一套变分推断服务多诊断
双视角汤姆逊散射、干涉与法拉第联合约束，给出带不确定性的空间分辨参数
烧蚀流区空间分辨电流与双极电场；统一解释阳极向倾斜与 zipper 种子
points_en: Shared Bayesian neural core + swappable forward models: one VI engine for many diagnostics
Dual-view Thomson, interferometry, and Faraday jointly constrain spatially resolved parameters with uncertainty
Spatially resolved currents and bipolar Er in ablation; unifies anode-directed tilt and zipper seeding
status_en: PRL, final round of review (minor revision)

themes.title_zh: 全动理学 / 混合 PIC
themes.lede_zh: 在 GPU 原生 PIC（WarpX）上扩展电流注入、外电路、嵌入线圈与隐式磁扩散，使 FRC、快 Z 箍缩与剪切流 Z 箍缩进入可算、可对标实验的区域。
themes.lede_en: Extending GPU-native PIC (WarpX) with current injection, external circuits, embedded coils, and implicit magnetic diffusion so FRC, fast Z-pinch, and shear-flow Z-pinch become computable and experiment-facing.
points_zh: 嵌入铜线圈 + 外电路自洽的全装置 3D 全动理学 FRC 形成；可复现端向 m=4 结构
约化参数 scaling、粒子化电流注入与 RLC 端口，适配显式 / hybrid 求解器
Hybrid-PIC 隐式磁扩散与状态依赖电阻率，面向等离子体—真空过渡与长时标剪切流柱
points_en: Device-scale 3D fully kinetic FRC formation with embedded coils and self-consistent circuits; recovers end-on m=4 structure
Reduced-c / mass scaling, particle current injection, and RLC ports for explicit and hybrid solvers
Hybrid-PIC implicit magnetic diffusion with state-dependent resistivity for plasma–vacuum transitions and long-pulse shear-flow columns

themes.lede_zh: GraphPulse：面向 LTD 级快脉冲功率源的全系统集中参数仿真，并把诊断—伪反演—健康度做成可部署的 Web 界面。
themes.lede_en: GraphPulse: full-system lumped-element simulation for LTD-class pulsed-power drivers, plus a deployable web UI for diagnostics, pseudo-inversion, and health monitoring.
points_zh: 水线 + Z 箍缩负载全链路；修正 MITL 鞘层漏电、PHC 闭合等关键损失
矩阵化求解：单次全系统仿真约秒级，支持故障植入与参数扫查
B-dot/V-dot → 电流/电压；腔体健康着色与跨炮趋势；下一步对接真反演与实测波形
points_en: End-to-end waterline + Z-pinch load; physics-based MITL sheath and PHC closure losses
Matrix solve at ~seconds per full-system run; fault injection and parameter sweeps
B-dot/V-dot to I/V; cavity health coloring and cross-shot trends; next: real inversion on measured waveforms
